Facebook Marketplace pickup and delivery in Columbia

Found the perfect deal but have no truck, no time, or no way across town? Pay the seller, book us online (no account needed), and we'll pick it up and bring it straight to your door today.

Get your instant price Send us a message

How it works

Agree on the item and pay the seller through Facebook, a payment app or however you both prefer. Then book a delivery with the seller's address as the pickup and yours as the drop-off, and add the seller's name and phone number so the driver can reach them. We pick it up, drive it straight to you, and send a photo when it's delivered. You can follow the driver on the map the whole way.

What we can bring

Chairs, small tables, nightstands, TVs, electronics, grills, patio items, bikes, kids' gear, tools, auto parts, boxes and décor, from Facebook Marketplace, OfferUp, Craigslist or a yard sale. Choose a car, minivan or pickup truck depending on the size, and have someone to load and unload.

Before you book

Please have someone at both ends to help load and unload, since the driver handles the drive, not the heavy lifting. Make sure you've paid the seller first: our drivers don't carry cash or collect payment for items. Measure big items so you pick a vehicle they'll fit in.

How it works

  1. 1. Get your price

    Enter the pickup and delivery addresses for an instant quote. No calling around.

  2. 2. Book in minutes

    Choose standard or Rush and a car, minivan or pickup truck, then pay securely online.

  3. 3. Track it live

    Follow the driver on the map. Delivery is confirmed with a photo, signature and GPS location.

Questions

Do you collect the payment from the seller for me?

No. Pay the seller before the pickup, through Facebook, a payment app or however you agree. Our drivers don't handle cash or item payments.

Can you inspect the item for me?

We don't inspect or test items, so check the photos and ask the seller questions first. We pick up exactly what the seller hands over and deliver it to you.

Can you move a couch or a big dresser?

Yes, if it fits in a pickup truck and you have people to load it at pickup and unload it at drop-off. Our driver transports it but doesn't do the lifting.
